public.title: Number of 1 Bits
public.description: Return the count of 1 bits in the unsigned 32-bit representation of n. Input n is an integer from 0 to 4294967295, including values whose top bit is set.
hints: Clearing the least significant set bit removes one 1.
Unsigned coercion preserves the full 32-bit input range.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Repeatedly clear the low set bit and increment a counter. O(k) time for k set bits, O(1) space.
